image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a small passerine bird, identified as a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), standing on grassy ground. The bird exhibits breeding male plumage characteristics: a black head and throat, bright orange-rufous breast and underparts, and black upperparts with distinct white shoulder patches and wing bars. The bill is short, conical, and yellowish-grey. The legs are pinkish-brown and slender. The background consists of blurred green grass and earth tones.
